name: Anthropic

summary.text: Anthropic is a privately held AI company founded by former OpenAI research executives; it develops the Claude models. Amazon has invested $8 billion as a minority investor without a board seat, Google holds about 14 percent according to court filings, and in November 2025 Microsoft and Nvidia agreed to invest up to $15 billion combined alongside a $30 billion Azure purchase commitment by Anthropic. In July 2025 the Pentagon's Chief Digital and AI Office awarded Anthropic a two-year prototype agreement with a $200 million ceiling.

facts.claim: Court documents reported by The New York Times in 2025 showed Google owns 14 percent of Anthropic, is capped at 15 percent, and had invested more than $3 billion across multiple rounds; in January 2025 Google agreed to a further $1 billion investment.

facts.claim: On November 18, 2025, Microsoft and Nvidia agreed to invest up to $15 billion combined in Anthropic (up to $5 billion and $10 billion respectively) as part of its next funding round, and Anthropic committed to buy $30 billion of Azure compute and to reserve up to one gigawatt of Nvidia hardware.

facts.claim: On July 14, 2025, the Department of Defense's Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office awarded Anthropic a two-year prototype other transaction agreement with a $200 million ceiling to prototype frontier AI capabilities for national security; Google and xAI received similar awards the same day, following a $200 million award to OpenAI the previous month.

openQuestions: A single Japanese blog post claims the Defense Department sought to change the contract terms in 2026 and that a federal judge ruled against a 'supply chain risk' designation of Anthropic in August 2026; no court record or major-outlet coverage was found and the claim was left out.
Amazon's and Google's percentage stakes after 2026 funding rounds and reports of further multi-billion commitments were not confirmed.
Anthropic's valuation after the November 2025 deal ($350 billion) appeared only in secondary coverage.
